title: Crypte des marées
style: Soft painterly stadium diorama, original design: no text, logos, ball emblems or recognisable venue. Crowd as a soft colour mass. Values one to two steps darker than the pixel-art creatures, calm and low-contrast behind them (stands band and landmark base), detail and the brightest accents kept to the upper sky and the edges.
plate: A bioluminescent sea cave. A dark rock vault frames an arch opening onto a moonlit teal sea; a bright waterfall column pours from the arch into a misty pool behind the stands. Wet rock galleries with glowing algae ledges, sea-lantern pillars, cyan and blue light spots on the rock.
court: Wet stone tiles with shallow puddles catching teal light, worn joints, shell inlays, pale sea-foam markings and an inlaid six-rhombus sigil.
value: Darkest arena overall; one bright vertical waterfall column in the centre.
